description: List the addresses that the waitlist block of a site took, newest first: the address, the page of the form and the time. Only a site that SHIP made with Start from scratch has a waitlist, and the list is empty until a page with the block is published. When more addresses exist, pass nextCursor back as cursor. The addresses are personal data: the call needs the site-waitlist:read scope and an owner or an admin of the workspace, and you use the addresses only for what the user asks.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page; omit for the first page

name: list_site_waitlist
title: List site waitlist
